senses.definition: a chief of the people, one of those sealed Ne 10:22 𝔊L Ιεδδουα.
a priest, prob. the high priest in time of Alexander the Great Ne 12:11, 22 𝔊 Ιαδου, 𝔊L Ιεδδου (whence LagBN 113 reads יִדּוּעַ).
